Online Launchpad

Skrillex: First of the Year (Equinox)

Your keyboard is the controller. The 4 by 12 block from 1 to Shift is the pad grid, and the arrow keys switch between four sound packs. Pads with a dot only sound while you hold them.

Samples are from Nev's project file for First of the Year (Equinox) by Skrillex, and belong to their owners, so keep this for personal use. Pad mapping, hold-to-play keys, and linked groups follow the original Online Launchpad by Daniel Weber (MIT).
